descriptions.w3d_d31e_check_array_unique_801d6220: Validates an object array property: for every pair of elements logs an error and clears the result when both have the same class, and logs a warning when one class derives from the other (walking parents at +20), each with lines naming both elements. Returns 1 when no exact duplicate was found. Names are inferred; the strings at 0x803af3c8.. are the log formats.
